title: Request to reset accidental early Track 2 submission (@josephmayo)

latest.raw:
Hello SageBio organizers,

I accidentally finalized my Track 2 submission earlier than intended while preparing my Track 1 and video materials. The submission is under the Hugging Face username `josephmayo`.

I understand that Track 2 permits only one final submission and that re-submissions are not allowed. Before making any further changes, could you please confirm whether the current Track 2 entry can be withdrawn or reset so I can continue iterating and submit one final entry before the deadline? I am not asking to retain or have multiple entries judged; if a reset is possible, the existing entry can be deleted or withdrawn.

I understand if the rules or system do not permit this. Thank you for considering the request.

latest.raw:
Hi @josephmayo,

Thank you for your interest and participation in the Hackathon! After discussing internally, we’ve decided to increase the Track 2 submission quota up to 3 attempts, and the submission instructions have been updated accordingly.

You are all set to submit your second attempt whenever you're ready! Please note that only your most recent submission will be evaluated by the judges.

Best of luck!

latest.raw:
Thank you so much, @vpchung and the SageBio team. I truly appreciate you discussing this internally and updating the Track 2 quota for everyone.

Allowing three attempts while judging only the most recent submission is a thoughtful and fair solution: it gives teams room to improve their methods responsibly without creating multiple judged entries. We will use the additional attempts carefully and make sure our final submission is the entry we genuinely want evaluated.

Thank you again for the flexibility, clarity, and all the work behind a challenge centered on helping this child and the broader MVA community. We are grateful for the opportunity and will do our very best with it.
